## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the change and link a related issue if there is one. Small fixes do not need a prior issue.

## Verification

State relevant checks and results, plus what remains untested. Use synthetic fixtures and sanitized output; do not attach private photos, face crops, embeddings, personal paths or raw runtime logs.

## Provenance

- [ ] Any added third-party material has its origin, license and required notices recorded, or there is none.

If AI tools helped, briefly state the relevant generation role and human verification (or say none). Do not disclose private prompts or confidential context. Sign-off is an attestation, not copyright assignment; commit identity and sign-off information are public.
